premise: The ship needs fuel to fly home and there's no fuel station on the Moon, so the excavator fetches crater ice and the oxygen plant splits it into air to breathe and rocket fuel.
inspiration: 'Aladdin' from 'The Arabian Nights', where a lamp holds a wish-granting genie, turned: no lamp and no genie — the magic is real chemistry, hidden in the ice.
lesson: What you need may already be right under your feet.
learning: Ice from the Moon can be split into the gases rockets burn as fuel.

en-US.title: Fuel from Ice
en-US.text: The huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship stood on the landing pad, ready to fly home. But its tanks were nearly empty. {ship:wobble} And there's no fuel station on the Moon. [curious] The Moon has something else, though, hidden in its coldest, darkest craters. The {excavator:enter} excavator trundled down {excavator:go to crater} into the crater, and there, frozen in the dust, was a chunk of {ice:enter} ice. It glittered in the dark. {ice:live} Frost spread over it, white and sparkling. {excavator:live} Scoop! {sfx:scoop} Up came the ice, and the excavator carried it to the {oxygen-plant:enter} oxygen plant. {excavator:go to oxygen-plant} Ice is made of water. {oxygen-plant:live} And the plant split the water into two gases: the very same ones rockets burn. [excited] Into the ship's tanks they went. {ship:sparkle} {sfx:whirr} {ship:live hold} The ship lowered its crew elevator, ready for the trip home. [proudly] {all:face happy} {all:hop} Everyone cheered. {excavator:hop} Fuel from the Moon itself!

es-ES.title: Combustible de hielo
es-ES.text: La enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave esperaba en la plataforma de aterrizaje, lista para volver a casa. Pero tenía los depósitos casi vacíos. {ship:wobble} Y en la Luna no hay gasolineras. [curious] Aunque la Luna tiene otra cosa, escondida en sus cráteres más fríos y oscuros. La {excavator:enter} excavadora bajó traqueteando {excavator:go to crater} al cráter, y allí, congelado en el polvo, había un trozo de {ice:enter} hielo. Brillaba en la oscuridad. {ice:live} La escarcha lo cubrió, blanca y reluciente. {excavator:live} ¡Palada! {sfx:scoop} Arriba fue el hielo, y la excavadora lo llevó a la {oxygen-plant:enter} planta de oxígeno. {excavator:go to oxygen-plant} El hielo es agua. {oxygen-plant:live} Y la planta separó el agua en dos gases: justo los que queman los cohetes. [excited] Fueron a los depósitos de la nave. {ship:sparkle} {sfx:whirr} {ship:live hold} La nave bajó su ascensor, lista para el viaje a casa. [proudly] {all:face happy} {all:hop} Todos lo celebraron. {excavator:hop} ¡Combustible de la propia Luna!

scoop.prompt: a machine scooping up a chunk of ice and gritty soil, a crunchy scrape

whirr.prompt: a smooth mechanical whir of a big elevator platform lowering, gentle hum
